title: Ex-German Spy Chief Arrested on Suspicion of Espionage and Treason
title_zh: 德国前情报局长因涉嫌间谍和叛国罪被捕
lead: August Hanning, who once led Germany's foreign intelligence service, has been arrested alongside a former subordinate accused of passing him thousands of classified documents. Prosecutors allege the pair maintained contacts with foreign spy agencies.
lead_zh: 曾执掌德国对外情报机构的奥古斯特·汉宁被捕，同时被捕的还有一名前下属，此人被控向他传递了数千份机密文件。检方称两人与外国间谍机构保持联系。

paragraphs: August Hanning, who headed the Federal Intelligence Service (BND) from 1998 to 2005 and subsequently worked as a private consultant, has been arrested on suspicion of espionage, treason and obtaining classified information for a foreign power, the German Federal Prosecutor's Office announced. Prosecutors allege that he drew on classified intelligence to "draft an analysis" for one foreign intelligence service while maintaining contact with yet another. Investigators have declined to identify which foreign powers were involved.

Police simultaneously arrested former BND employee Manfred D, accusing him of furnishing Hanning with roughly 2,000 classified documents in exchange for money. Manfred D, who served as Hanning's bureau chief and remained at the BND until this year, faces charges of aiding and abetting attempted treason and treasonous espionage. According to local media, Hanning was apprehended at his home in Nordwalde near Münster, whereas Manfred D was arrested in Bavaria. Hanning is due in court on Wednesday, Manfred D on Tuesday.

Prosecutors contend that Manfred D, who also acted as chief of staff for Hanning's successors between 2012 and 2026, exploited his position to access highly confidential material, which he then passed to Hanning "in exchange for remuneration". "The current findings suggest that, over the years, Manfred D provided Hanning with approximately 2,000 documents, many of which contained classified information to be used exclusively by the Federal Intelligence Service for internal purposes," the statement reads.

On one occasion, Hanning allegedly used classified intelligence to draft an analysis for an officer of a foreign intelligence service, though prosecutors concede it remains unclear whether "the material reached the intended recipient". He is further accused of having been "in close contact with a representative of another foreign intelligence service, to whom he passed on political information, partially based on material provided by Manfred D, for several years".

Local media report that Hanning's alleged possession of intelligence documents surfaced during a separate case involving Christina Block, a German steakhouse heiress whom Hamburg prosecutors accused of orchestrating the 2023 kidnapping of her two youngest children amid a custody dispute. Investigators allege Hanning was involved in an earlier attempted kidnapping of the children, which he denies. State criminal police officers reportedly discovered an electronic storage device containing sensitive information, including recent BND documents.

This is hardly the first controversy of its kind to engulf the BND. In 2023, a high-ranking German intelligence officer was charged with treason for allegedly passing state secrets to Russia. Prosecutors alleged that Carsten L shared intelligence concerning the war in Ukraine and the Wagner mercenary group and received roughly €400,000 ($450,000; £340,000). His trial is ongoing.
paragraphs_zh: 德国联邦检察官办公室宣布，曾于1998年至2005年执掌联邦情报局（BND）、此后从事私人咨询工作的奥古斯特·汉宁因涉嫌间谍活动、叛国以及为外国势力获取机密信息而被捕。检方称，汉宁利用机密情报为一个外国情报机构“撰写分析报告”，同时与另一个外国情报机构保持联系。调查人员拒绝透露涉及哪些外国势力。
警方同时逮捕了BND前雇员曼弗雷德·D，指控他以金钱为交换向汉宁提供了大约2000份机密文件。曼弗雷德·D曾任汉宁的办公室主任，并一直留在BND直到今年，面临协助和教唆未遂叛国罪以及叛国间谍罪的指控。据当地媒体报道，汉宁在明斯特附近的诺德瓦尔德家中被捕，而曼弗雷德·D则在巴伐利亚被捕。汉宁将于周三出庭，曼弗雷德·D将于周二出庭。
检方称，曼弗雷德·D在2012年至2026年间还担任过汉宁继任者的幕僚长，他利用职务之便获取高度机密信息，然后“以获取报酬为交换”将其传递给汉宁。声明称：“目前的调查结果表明，多年来，曼弗雷德·D向汉宁提供了大约2000份文件，其中许多包含仅供联邦情报局内部使用的机密信息。”
据称，汉宁曾有一次利用机密情报为某外国情报机构的一名官员撰写分析报告，但检方承认，目前尚不清楚“这些材料是否送达了预定接收人”。他还被指控“多年来与另一个外国情报机构的代表保持密切联系，并向其传递政治信息，部分信息基于曼弗雷德·D提供的材料”。
当地媒体报道称，汉宁涉嫌持有情报文件一事是在另一起涉及德国牛排连锁店女继承人克里斯蒂娜·布洛克的案件中被发现的。汉堡检方指控布洛克因监护权纠纷策划了2023年绑架她两个年幼子女的事件。调查人员称汉宁参与了更早一次绑架孩子的未遂企图，但他予以否认。据报道，州刑事警察在调查中发现了一个电子存储设备，内含敏感信息，包括近期的BND文件。
这并非BND首次陷入此类争议。2023年，一名德国高级情报官员因涉嫌向俄罗斯传递国家机密而被控叛国罪。检方称，卡斯滕·L分享了有关乌克兰战争和瓦格纳雇佣军集团的情报，并收受了约40万欧元（45万美元；34万英镑）。他的审判仍在进行中。

title_original: Former German spy chief arrested for espionage and treason

Former German spy chief arrested for espionage and treason
By
Olivia Ireland
Published
6 hours ago
Former German spy chief August Hanning has been arrested on suspicion of espionage, treason and obtaining classified information for a foreign power, the German Federal Prosecutor's Office says.
Hanning headed the Federal Intelligence Service (BND) from 1998 to 2005 and has since been working as a private consultant.
Prosecutors allege that he used classified intelligence to "draft an analysis" for one foreign intelligence service and maintained contact with another foreign spying service. Investigators have not disclosed which foreign powers were involved.
Police also arrested former BND employee Manfred D, accusing him of passing Hanning about 2,000 classified documents for money.
Manfred D, who was Hanning's bureau chief and remained in the BND until this year, is charged with aiding and abetting attempted treason and treasonous espionage.
Local media reported Hanning was arrested at his home in Nordwalde near Münster while Manfred D was arrested in Bavaria. Hanning is due in court on Wednesday and Manfred D will appear on Tuesday.
Prosecutors say Manfred D, who also served as the chief of staff for Hanning's successors between 2012 and 2026, used his role to gain access to highly confidential information which he then passed on to Hanning "in exchange for remuneration".
"The current findings suggest that, over the years, Manfred D provided Hanning with approximately 2,000 documents, many of which contained classified information to be used exclusively by the Federal Intelligence Service for internal purposes," the statement says.
"On one occasion, Hanning used classified intelligence ... to draft an analysis for an officer of a foreign intelligence service," prosecutors said, noting it was not clear if "the material reached the intended recipient".
Hanning is also accused of being "in close contact with a representative of another foreign intelligence service, to whom he passed on political information, partially based on material provided by Manfred D, for several years".
Local media say Hanning's alleged possession of intelligence documents came to light during a separate case relating to German steakhouse heiress Christina Block.
Hamburg public prosecutor's office accused Block of orchestrating the kidnapping of her two youngest children in 2023 due to a custody dispute. Investigators allege Hanning was involved in an earlier attempted kidnapping of the children, which he denies.
State criminal police officers reportedly discovered an electronic data storage device containing sensitive information including recent BND documents.
It is not the first time the BND has faced similar controversy. A high-ranking German intelligence officer was
charged with treason in 2023
for allegedly passing state secrets to Russia.
Prosecutors alleged Carsten L shared intelligence about the war in Ukraine and the Wagner mercenary group and received roughly €400,000 ($450,000; £340,000). His trial is ongoing.
